text:
alex_ryan: Heads up — I'm updating SDK snippets for streaming helpers across py/ts/go. PR (WIP): https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482. Main change: async iterator now yields (chunk, meta) instead of just chunk. This will affect migration guides and a few quickstart examples.
maria.g: Thanks. Which pages are impacted?
alex_ryan: streaming.md, sdk/migration.md, and snippets/* (python, typescript, go). Also client quickstart shows old pattern.
jonathan: Can we keep compatibility with a tiny shim in Python? e.g. `for item in stream: chunk = item[0] if isinstance(item, tuple) else item`
maria.g: I think we should update examples to the new shape (users need meta), but include a short migration snippet showing the shim so folks don't break immediately.
docs-bot: CI: docs build failed — snippet-tests failing in python example (test_snippet_streaming.py:42). See https://ci.redwood.com/build/9876
alex_ryan: Pushed a fix to the PR: updated python snippet to show type-hint + shim, updated TS example to show array destructuring and a fallback, and drafted a Go example. Will paste snippets below.
jonathan: ```
# python snippet
async for item in stream:
    chunk, meta = item if isinstance(item, tuple) else (item, None)
    process(chunk)
```
maria.g: For TS please show both patterns. Example:
```ts
// preferred
for await (const [chunk, meta] of stream) {
  process(chunk)
}
// fallback
const item = await stream.next();
const [chunk, meta] = Array.isArray(item) ? item : [item, null];
```
alex_ryan: Added both patterns. For Go I used a struct payload on the channel: `type StreamMsg struct { Chunk []byte; Meta map[string]interface{} }` and example receive:
```go
msg := <-streamCh
process(msg.Chunk)
```
maria.g: Also fixed an old anchor link in streaming.md — changed `#streaming-changes` -> `#stream-changes`. Added a redirect note in the top of the page and updated two internal links.
jonathan: :thumbsup: Please add a brief note in the SDK CHANGELOG about the Go channel payload struct change so Dedicated/private customers can plan an upgrade.
alex_ryan: Done — added CHANGELOG entry and a manual test on a Dedicated stack. Still hitting a prettier lint error on the TS snippets. @maria.g can you run `prettier --write` on docs/ts-snippets?
maria.g: On it. Pushed commit with formatting fixes.
docs-bot: CI: docs build succeeded. All snippet-tests passed. ✅
alex_ryan: Thanks all. Plan: merge PR at 14:00 PT after a final docs review. If you see edge cases, comment on the PR. I'll backport a compatibility shim to the 1.2.x branch and add a short migration note in sdk/migration.md."
